jezero.projection: Equirectangular Mars 2000 sphere; planetocentric latitude; positive east longitude
jezero.notes: Actual MRO Context Camera orbital imagery. Preliminary uncontrolled mosaic; no terrain elevation or safety certification. Pixel geometry is geographic, not Earth Web Mercator. JPEG rendering from source tiles; grayscale unchanged.
jezero.topographic_credit: NASA/JPL/GSFC; Mars Global Surveyor MOLA color shaded relief
jezero.topographic_notes: Real MOLA color shaded relief. Source product label nominal 463m; rendered geographic pixel spacing is about 325m north-south at selected tile level. Color is a visualization, not a numeric elevation grid. Fractional pixel resampling aligns these exact bounds with the CTX layer.
